seal.statement: The read-only overflow-budget audit was superseded after its third verification round upheld its content - 25 of 27 matrix rows, all nine enforcement-entry-gate statuses and three architectural results - and rejected it on three ordinary defects: two hand-off rows carry does_not_depend together with explicit-authority-required; the receipts a row cites are pointers to a test file and are not bound to the row, field, value or domain they are said to prove, so a flipped dependency citing an unrelated test stays green and any row may claim producer reachability by citing a file that calls itself real-chain; and a finding's open flag and a required external artifact's exists flag are hand-written booleans from which a gate item can be made demonstrated. This quest makes that inherited audit trustworthy enough to freeze, and does nothing else. It corrects five-relocation-handoff-overlap and ledger-relocation-handoff-overlap to the existing disposition that fits a measured does_not_depend, qualified by its domain - a budget-dependent authority requirement is unreachable within the ordinary hand-off domain, the relocation itself stays reachable and legitimate, the spread-recovery two-owner finding is kept, and no ledger authority appears - and lets gate item 3 follow from the corrected rows by derivation. It replaces pointer receipts with receipts a measuring test emits and asserts, each binding the matrix row id, the receipt kind, the classification field, the expected value, the stated domain, the witness identity and the result that witness produced, so that the validator demands the binding rather than the file, a receipt for one row never satisfies another, a receipt for one value never satisfies another, and a real-chain receipt names the row and the producer and transition facts its drive established. It removes hand-written truth: a finding is resolved only by a resolution artifact on disk that names the finding and carries a compatible result, and a required external artifact is satisfied only by what the repository holds - its existence, its kind, the gate requirement it names and, where it is a quest, its sealed and approved state - so gate status is a pure, monotonic derivation from validated evidence that no removal, corruption, substitution or metadata edit can improve, and item 8 stays not-yet. It pins the round-3 content of the 25 upheld rows and every other inherited value so that anything but the authorized D3 correction turns a receipt red, keeps the architectural results as results, and on an independent approving verification freezes the corrected matrix, the gate document, the evidence bindings and the surviving findings behind a manifest that names that verification.

text: Lead ruling on D3's representation, measured in phase 1: the inherited validator lets proved-unreachable mean only that the over-target GUARD STATE is unreachable (dependency unreachable_in_stated_domain, guardReachable no, no budget-evaluated partition covered). The two hand-off rows cannot take that shape without falsifying two facts round 3 upheld - measured does_not_depend and guardReachable yes through the real chain - and their partition classes are exactly the budget-evaluated set. still-unclassified is the only disposition the unchanged validator accepts and is false: the rows are classified. The owner's direction anticipates this: 'If that disposition is proved-unreachable, state precisely what is unreachable: a budget-dependent authority requirement is unreachable within this hand-off domain.' Ruling: both rows become proved-unreachable with a structured domainQualification whose subject is budget-dependent-authority-requirement; the seven existing proved rows keep their discipline byte-identically under the default subject (the guard state); the new subject gets an equally strict discipline of its own - measured does_not_depend with a complete-domain row-bound receipt, no admission class, proposed kind none, guardReachable unchanged, a qualification that may not say the relocation or operation is unreachable, and the partition check inverted (the budget IS evaluated there and makes no difference). This names a state the inherited disposition conflated (R07); it adds no disposition, dependency value, class or row. It is a judgment the verifier is asked to attack and the owner may overrule before the freeze.

Owner decision 2026-09-20 (recorded on main ff6d83fa4, addendum to owner-direction-audit-successor-2026-09-20.md): the D3 ruling is accepted in substance and tightened. The subject of proved-unreachable is a validated two-value enum - guard-admission-state on the seven inherited rows, budget-dependent-authority-requirement on the two hand-off rows - explicit on every proved-unreachable row; the validator selects the proof discipline from the subject with no row-specific case; the new subject requires guardReachable yes, inherited producerReachable, does_not_depend, a row-bound differential receipt over the complete stated domain with actual-budget and zero-budget executions and zero decision differences, and membership in the budget-evaluated set; seven cross-subject mutants must fail; no new taxonomy; and one further freeze invariant - a prose-blind reader of the structured matrix and validated receipts determines what each disposition asserts and what proves it, or there is no freeze. These strengthen the sealed receipts d3-handoff-rows-corrected-with-domain-qualification and freeze-manifest-names-an-approving-verification-and-matches-the-frozen-bytes; they weaken nothing sealed. The verifier reports separately on D1, D2, D3, cross-subject substitution, the 25 inherited rows, the chained-REPLACE witness, the nine derived gate statuses and the absence of production changes.

Phase 2 by the Opus implementer under the lead's brief and the owner's tightening. D3: both hand-off rows proved-unreachable with the structural subject budget-dependent-authority-requirement (enum explicit on all nine proved-unreachable rows; seven inherited rows carry guard-admission-state as their only added field); the validator selects the proof discipline from a subject-keyed table with no row-id branch; gate item 3 selects one row, its pin 3 to 1 recorded as correctionToRound3, status derived and unchanged. D2: 36 receipts of 7 kinds emitted and asserted by the measuring tests and compared to the committed store, bound to row, field, value, domain id, witness and run-produced result (state counts, evaluations with the actual and the zeroed budget, decision differences); the census-conditional dependency has its own kind carrying both measured halves; real-chain receipts name the row's producer and the drive's facts. D1: findings lose open and external artifacts lose exists; both derive from repository observation taking a repo root; item 8 stays not-yet. Mutants against the real validator in a fixture tree: 10 cross-subject, 17 binding, 5 round-3 attacks, 11 monotonicity. Round-3 pin with a declared minimal exclusion list; the lead's independent diff of the matrix against the inherited version shows exactly two changed values. Prose-blind projection and presence-dependence measurement; freeze writer refuses without an approving verification. The closed audit's evidence script deleted, its 12 recorded commands re-run from the closed record. Probe metric 1: only the freeze receipt red, as intended. No production path changed.

round 1 REJECT at staged tree 4d353db0c4e4 (3 blocking, all ORDINARY, none architectural; subject tree byte-identical after verification). Upheld: D1 PASS - the literal round-3 attack and every audit-metadata edit refused or without gain, item 8 not-yet throughout, 71,213 single-path fuzz mutants through the real derivation with 0 improvements; D3 content PASS - both rows proved-unreachable under the structural subject, differential re-measured by the verifier (1440 hand-off states per partition, both evaluations each, 0 differences, budget non-zero in 1080 of 1440 so not vacuous), ledger sentence verbatim, no ledger authority, item 3 derived; the owner's seven cross-subject mutants and nine more refused; the 25 inherited rows PASS by the verifier's own 77-path diff and a recomputation of the pin over the inherited matrix (0 mismatches, pin static and not self-fulfilling); the chained-REPLACE witness PASS (hunks are imports, counters, appended emission; no drive, state or assertion altered); nine gate statuses equal round 3; no production change. B1 BLOCKING: receipt row, kind, domain and producer identity are echoed from the matrix rather than produced by the measurement - emitters loop matrix rows by witness pointer, choose kind from the row's pointer fields, domain from kind, producer from row.producers (the validator's check is then circular), facts by an id-suffix convention in new code; receipts carry no driven or measured partition, so ledger rows hold guard-reachability and a real-chain dependence receipt from the single drive on sql_transactions-p1. Exploits run with validator AND emission check green, only the pin refusing: X1 ledger hand-off row claims producerReachable yes and the chain test emits its receipt; X2 three still-unclassified depends ADD rows moved to does_not_depend + proved-unreachable + the new subject by matrix edits and regeneration. The pin is what a legitimate re-audit re-takes, so the binding must hold without it. Root: the row-to-domain relation is prose plus a self-declared domain id. B2 BLOCKING for freeze: matrix markdown prints unreachable subject undefined on exactly the two D3 rows (render reads qualification.subject), and the seven inherited subjects are not rendered. B3 BLOCKING for freeze: gate item 3's rowSelection string still says at least 3 rows above one selected row - hand-written pinned prose that should render from the contract. Non-blocking: resolution artifacts self-declared with free-string kind and a substring requirement match; validator trusts the store's own domain registry and emission compares receipts only; censusRefined leftover in evidence-binding.test.js; mixed difference definitions and misnamed statesWhenCensusNotMoved (it is the hand-off slice, not the complement; 4100 differences lie in non-moved states of other classes); fail-open no-production test; freeze writer does not bind the approval to verified bytes, runs neither pin nor emission check, ignores file order for a later rejection, and omits the pin, render and receipt-emission sources from the digest; a false no-row-id comment; justification and doesNotImply unrendered and unvalidated. Prose-blind invariant PARTIALLY met: validator and derivation are prose-independent, but the reader cannot determine which states a row covers without prose. Inherited weaknesses reported, not fixed: ledger rows witnessed by a five-partition drive; gate items 2, 3, 4 list blocking findings without requiring them resolved. Inherited facts found false: none. Freeze judgment: NO at this tree.

Corrective attempt answering verification round 1 (B1, B2, B3 and every non-blocking item), by the Opus implementer under the lead's repair brief and two lead reviews. B1: receipts name no row; each carries what the run observed - dimension (partition, arithmetic, drive, census), measured partitions, a slice id from a structural slice registry read in code, producer and operation type taken at the drive's call site, run-produced counters - and the validator proves the measurement is about the row: exact coverage of row.partitionClass, the slice its subject and dependency require, slice operation type within producerOperationTypes, provenance through a drive whose producer the row declares. X1 and X2 refused with the pin absent; closing X2 needed only the inherited producerOperationTypes and producers, no new content on inherited rows. Guard-reachability discipline follows what the row's pinned round-3 witness measures: arithmetic witness => its per-class arithmetic receipt plus partition-grid coverage; drive on a covered partition => that drive plus coverage; drive on an uncovered partition => a structural, both-ways-checked witness discrepancy, of which exactly two exist (the ledger hand-off and ledger census-disagreement rows). Three inherited weaknesses recorded unrepaired for the re-audit: blocking findings listed but not required on gate items 2-4; ledger rows witnessed by a five-partition drive; two paired-relocation rows whose arithmetic witness measures nothing row-specific (set derived from the data and required equal to the declaration). B2: subject rendered for all nine rows, no rendered undefined or null. B3: rowSelection rendered from the gate contract and validated equal; the matrix value diff against round 3 is three declared values (two dispositions, item 3's selection text). Resolution and external artifacts observed as sealed, approved, solved quests through declared fields with closed-enum kinds; census-conditional evidence is two receipts over two named slices; the no-production test fails closed and measures from sealedAt; whole-store emission comparison. Freeze writer requires the token audit-freeze-digest:<sha256> in the approving verification text, re-runs validator, pin and emission, lets file order decide a later rejection, and digests six documents plus ten sources. Probe metric 1: only the freeze receipt red. Digest at this attempt: 723b090294d357500dda48b12923d25c74d5ab4a93a14ac21ff1e3176485aaa1.

round 2 REJECT at staged tree e1dfc98e8311 (2 blocking, both ORDINARY, none architectural; no inherited fact found false; subject tree byte-identical afterwards; the verifier's own digest equals the hand-over digest 723b0902 and is NOT issued as an approval token). PASS: D1 (literal attack and every audit-metadata edit refused or without gain, item 8 not-yet throughout, 76,041 fuzz mutants 0 improvements; a fully forged solver quest record is judged the legitimate satisfaction form); D3 (both rows under the structural subject; per partition 720 REPLACE hand-off states, both evaluations, 0 differences, budget non-zero in 540, and the test still asserts 0 over the full 1440 so the claim is sharpened; ledger sentence verbatim; no ledger authority; item 3 derived); the owner's seven cross-subject mutants plus eleven more refused; the 25 inherited rows by the verifier's own 77-path diff, pin recomputed over the inherited matrix with 0 mismatches, twelve pin attacks refused; chained-REPLACE witness untouched (hunks are imports, constants, counters, appended emission; enumerated domain 30240 per partition, 151200 over the five); nine statuses equal round 3; no production change; literal X1 and X2 refused without the pin; exactly two witness discrepancies is the true set and both directions are enforced; B3 gone. BLOCKING-1: the B1 root survives one level up - every field the validator matches a measurement against (producers, producerOperationTypes, partitionClass, admissionClasses, pinned witness pointers) is declared by the row itself and guarded by a mechanical census only against producer removal. A row that adds the follow-up producer and REPLACE to its own fields, empties admissionClasses and takes the new subject passes the validator individually for all 18 non-proved rows; re-pointing four rows moves gate item 4 from not-yet to DEMONSTRATED with validator and emission check green, only the pin and one snapshot assertion refusing - a literal violation of the owner's monotonicity clause on substituted evidence. Also green but for the pin: a ledger row claiming the five's partition class, a row shrinking its partitions, a depends row moved under guard-admission-state by re-pointing its partition, a depends ADD row flipped to does_not_depend. Guards found: producers - membership and at-least-one-row coverage only; producerOperationTypes - none; partitionClass - union coverage only; admissionClasses - at-least-one-claimant only. Repair sketch in validator scope: producerOperationTypes equal to the union of the declared producers' censused addLikeTypes; the slice's operation type covering every declared type for does_not_depend or the authority subject; type-aware census coverage; refuse two rows stating the same (producers, partitions, slice) proposition; bind owner-named rows to their partition. BLOCKING-2: the matrix markdown prints 'resolved only by owner-repair-quest at undefined' eleven times (render reads resolution.artifact, the field is resolution.path) and the placeholder guard is anchored to ': undefined' at end of line so it misses it. Non-blocking: the corrective attempt's claim that file order decides a later rejection is FALSE in both the freeze writer and the artifact observation (both compare ts); options.gatesHold bypasses the writer's gates; the digest omits the admitted-case grid test that now emits, the guard-driving support module, the evidence-support module and the pin test; the emission check discovers witnesses from the store it checks (downgrade only); slice-provenance facts not required true; producer-not-driven partitions echoed from the matrix; unknown-row and duplicate discrepancy entries and deletion of two inheritedWeaknesses not refused; weaknesses and slice predicates not rendered; stale comments. Prose-blind: structural for the nine proved rows and the mint row; the seventeen still-unclassified rows' triggering conditions live only in prose. Freeze judgment: NO.

Corrective attempt answering verification round 2. BLOCKING-1: every self-declared row field the validator matches a measurement against is now anchored to a mechanical census the audit already holds - producerOperationTypes equals the union of the row's producers' censused addLikeTypes; partitionClass is exactly a measured named partition set or the one partition an owner-named row stands for, within the producers' censused scope; the coverage census is type-aware (143 producer x partition x type triples); a proven independence claim must be measured over every operation type the row's producers can emit; no two rows may state the same proven proposition (key read from receipt sliceId). The unmutated matrix satisfies every new rule with 0 violations, so no inherited row was in question. The verifier's A4 (item 4 demonstrated), all 18 single-row re-pointings, p1-p5 are refused with the pin and the promoted-items snapshot out of the picture; c8 stays green as an honest correction. BLOCKING-2: resolution.path rendered; the placeholder guard moved to the producer (renderedValue throws on undefined, null, NaN, object) because inherited prose legitimately contains those words; slice predicates, discrepancies, the three inherited weaknesses and the non-gating note under items 2-4 rendered. File order, not ts, now decides a later rejection in both the freeze writer and the artifact observation (three mutants) - correcting a false claim in the previous attempt. gatesHold bypass removed; digest covers 15 paths; emission witnesses are a code constant; slice-provenance facts required true; closed key sets on findings, resolutions and artifacts. Residue still guarded only by the pin, reported for the owner: which admission classes a row claims (a shrink stays green), all free-text content, the seventeen still-unclassified rows' distinguishing conditions, the round-3 witness pointer text, and the whole inherited prose sections. Lead's independent diff: three declared changed values, no new field on any inherited row. Probe metric 1. Digest efcd0c70d1aaa2c72228945299917a71fdb2aa554991ce1ffad03a0af39ce347.

round 3 REJECT at staged tree 2502030f06d7 (subject byte-identical afterwards; the verifier's digest efcd0c70 equals hand-over and is NOT issued as a token). THE SAME ROOT SURVIVES A THIRD TIME and is classified ARCHITECTURAL. Round 1: receipts echoed the row. Round 2: the row fields receipts are matched against were self-declared. Round 3: the censuses those fields were anchored to are partly hand-written matrix content - matrix.producers[].addLikeTypes and partitionScope.partitionIds are read by no measuring test (the add-like census measures only the sink call sites and the cure conditions; the corrective attempt's claim of a mechanical anchor is false for them, and editing addLikeTypes to nonsense stays green everywhere but the pin) - and the join from a row to the census, row.producers, is self-declared. Eight producer re-declarations (seven guard-admission-state rows re-declare a REPLACE-only producer, four REPLACE-only still-unclassified rows add an ADD producer) move gate item 4 from not-yet to DEMONSTRATED with validator, producer-census test, partition-sets test and emission check green and a regenerated store identical to the committed one; only the pin and two promoted-items snapshots refuse. 16 of 24 directed variants succeed. Also green but for the pin or row-id-keyed snapshot assertions inside measuring tests: a census-disagreement row re-pointed to the hand-off proposition over the six-partition set; a depends row flipped to does_not_depend with its disposition unchanged (a proven claim about the wrong states); still-unclassified changed to explicit-authority-required; ownerNamedSeven grown. Why architectural: no mechanical source exists for which producers and which states a row stands for; a row's identity is its prose triggering condition, seventeen rows share producers, partitions and dependency by round 3's own design, and the gate contract selects on those self-declared fields. Closing it needs a structured, measured state-and-producer definition for every row - new content on the 25 inherited rows and a re-audit, outside the owner's scope section and squarely his section 9. Every narrower patch closes one instance and leaves the next undeclared join. UPHELD for the third time: D1 (19 attacks, item 8 not-yet throughout); D2 as scoped (receipts are honest: counters at the evaluation sites, producer and type at the drive call site, no row id emitted; hand edits die on emission); D3 (720 states per partition, both evaluations, 0 differences, budget non-zero in 540, all six partitions; ledger sentence verbatim; no ledger authority; item 3 derived; 20 of 21 mutants refused, the survivor a prose paraphrase); the owner's seven cross-subject mutants plus fourteen; the 25 inherited rows by the verifier's own leaf diff (3 changed values, producers and partitionSets byte-equal to round 3, pin recomputed with 0 mismatches, 12 pin attacks refused); the chained-REPLACE witness; nine statuses equal round 3; no production change; round 2's attacks all refused without the pin; freeze writer refusal paths including file order. BLOCKING-2 ORDINARY: literal null printed twice in the slice predicate rendering (unrestricted fields), and the renderer guard is opt-in - deleting correctionToRound3 fields prints undefined with all three freeze gates green. Non-blocking: digest omits the partition-sets test, the evidence-binding test hosting the emission gate and others, and the partition-sets test is not a freeze gate; ownerNamedSeven and the remainder list are not compared by the partition-sets test; the validator has no depends-implies-classes rule; measuring tests carry row-id-keyed snapshot assertions acting as an unacknowledged second pin; the implementer's pin-only residue list was incomplete (row.producers, addLikeTypes, partitionScope, unclassified-versus-authority on unique-key rows, semanticOwner, repairGroup, ownerNamedPartition, correctionToRound3 fields). Prose-blind invariant: met for the nine proved rows and the mint row; for the seventeen still-unclassified rows 'unclassified, whole-grid depends' is determinable and would suffice for a record of ignorance, but what makes a row THAT row is prose, and that is the lever of the defect. Inherited facts found false: none. Freeze judgment: NO. Recommendation: stop and report to the owner under section 9.

Lead stop. Three verification rounds, three rejections on one root, the third classified architectural by an independent verifier: a matrix row's identity - which producers and which states it stands for - has no mechanical source. The owner's direction section 9 applies: trustworthy row-bound evidence cannot be represented with the current audit machinery without a larger change (a structured, measured state-and-producer definition per row, which is new content on the inherited rows and a re-audit). No fourth repair is attempted, the matrix is not frozen, and nothing downstream starts. What stands, upheld three times and staged unfrozen: the D3 correction under the structural subject with its non-vacuous zero-difference differential; honest run-produced receipts; artifact-derived findings and observed external artifacts with item 8 not-yet; the 25 inherited rows unchanged; the chained-REPLACE witness; nine statuses equal to round 3. Next owner: judgment - the owner chooses how the audit's evidence is to be held given that row identity is prose.

Stopped by owner decision 2026-09-20 as rejected-by-architecture; not a validator defect and not to be repaired. Three independent verification rounds established: the audit matrix has no mechanically authoritative definition of what makes a row represent a particular producer and state condition; for the seventeen still-unclassified rows that identity lives in prose. No fourth repair, no further successor strengthening this matrix representation, no freeze manifest: the 27-row matrix is NOT frozen. Preserved: the three verification reports in full, the three corrective attempts in this log, the attack scripts, the exact verified staged tree 24370784febda5c40e3a8484aae9205c43707369 (commit 966231c6e, local tag audit-evidence-binding/round-3-verified-tree; branch commit 52b5ef5f7 differs only in two hook-regenerated files, the owner-debt inventory and the import-graph seal), and the fact that no production file changed. The propositions the verifiers did establish structurally are carried by a separate sealed records-only verified evidence packet under the epic, which is neither a frozen matrix nor an authority specification. The seventeen prose-identified rows stay historical material: their row ids are not canonical semantic identities and carry no gate weight in a future enforcement design until re-established under a production-derived structural model. Known unrepaired rendering defects, left so the rejected tree stays unchanged: a literal null printed twice in the slice-predicate lines of the matrix markdown; the renderer's placeholder guard is opt-in. Carried forward: the next model must obtain the identity of the semantic state being measured from production-owned transition state, never from audit-authored row declarations.
